The '''T-06 hull''' was a modular [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Hull/Legends|hull]] manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. It was equipped with twin [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] mounts, two [[Shield booster/Legends|shield booster]] mounts and had a triple [[Fuel cell/Legends|fuel cell]] capacity. It cost 600 [[Wupiupi/Legends|wupiupi credits]].<ref name="JGG" />
